Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Start from molecule_dictionary for CHEMBL941 as parent. Use molecule_hierarchy to include the parent and all child salts. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno for compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id for pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Join activities on compound_records.record_id. Join assays on activities.assay_id for assay_description. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid for target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and target CHEMBL1936. Sort by all output columns ascending. No row limit.
